decision.reason: [ev-3f6039ca92c8] says, under "Deprecated configuration options are removed", that `split_queries_by_interval` has been removed from the `query_range` YAML section and should now be set in limits_config. limits_config is another section of Loki's own configuration, not an upstream mechanism, so superseded-upstream is the wrong kind. The vocabulary defines a removed or relocated key as setting-ignored: a value left under query_range is no longer honoured there. The evidence does not say whether Loki ignores the old key or refuses the config, so setting-ignored is the minimum consequence the evidence supports.
